Https:// kya aap ghutne ke dard se pareshan hain? matr 9 minat ke in aasan yogasnon se ghutne ki majbuti barhaen aur dard se turant rahat paen.
Ghutne ka dard aajkal ek aam samasya ban gaee hai, jo chalne-phirne aur dainik karyon men badha dalti hai. is vidiyo men ham 7 bahut hi saral aur prabhavi abhyason ke bare men bat karenge, jo vishesh rup se ghutne ki eksarsaij ke rup men taiyar kie gae hain. in abhyason ko karne se aapke ghutnon ke aaspas ki manspeshiyan majbut hoti hain aur dard men kaphi aaram milta hai.
